collectionDesign.type: Predefined5x5 cyclic Latin position-balanced blocks; not random and not fully carryover-balanced.
collectionDesign.workflow: Use order.json; do not collect five consecutive runs of one method. Clear VOFA history before reset, keep all107 channels, verify build/factor identity. Secure same unloaded setup and origin; do not manually move during control. Fresh controller reset each attempt; no warm-start weights. Record battery voltage and any recharge/pause/cooldown; no per-method tuning. Maintain comparable power state; never lower safety limits to complete a run.
collectionDesign.attemptPolicy: Exactly25 planned independent attempts, not25 selected successes. Retain faults, all exports and logs. No overwriting or deleting a failed run; extra export of SAME history gets_full suffix, genuinely new replacement attempts get_attempt02 suffix and remain linked to the original. A fault pauses collection for review. If controller/method/condition changes, start a separate protocol/version; do not mix.
collectionDesign.powerAndSafety: Unchanged23..30V runtime battery guard is an operating protection, not a charging recommendation. Follow device charging instructions; don't change power arrangement by method. On abnormal oscillation/noise/travel stop safely; retain at least5sec of same post-fault history before reset/clear.

analysis.motionPopulation: All observed phase2..5 samples of an identity-valid full boot; source time/counter/phase progression must be consistent. Source positions/reference are metres at6decimal precision. Single pre-boot invalid transition rows may be excluded only by preregistered identity/time boundary; preserve raw and list exact rows. Never exclude an otherwise valid trial because of poor performance.

analysis.interpretation: Use block-matched differences and show every trial, mean/spread and uncertainty. With5 repeats evidence is limited; do not promise statistical significance. No choosing a favorite metric/version post hoc. If tracking/sync trade off, report the tradeoff, not universal superiority. Stationary/integer replay and assumed-model exactness do not establish closed-loop stability.
analysis.faultMetrics: Faulted/truncated trials retained in fault outcomes; do not compare their shortened RMSE as equal to full-duration completed runs or fill missing motion with zero. Report completion denominators and measurement missingness explicitly.
